newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks drop over one pct in brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks drop over one pct in brisk trade.

text.p: * Toronto stocks sank over one percent in brisk afternoon trading on Friday * Strong golds partly offset heavy losses in 13 of 14 sub-groups * 56 million shares traded worth C$956 million
Toronto stocks sank over one percent in brisk afternoon trading on Friday, snapping a three-day rally on Canada's biggest stock market.
The TSE 300 Composite Index was off 85.07 points, or 1.22 percent, to 6860.60.
About 56 million shares were traded worth C$956 million.

"Everbody has been worried about the steep ascent of the Dow and TSE. Profit taking was going to happen at some point amd the catalyst for this was weakness in the bond markets," said Katherine Beattie, a technical analyst with MMS International.
Canada's 30-year long bond was down C$1.18 to C$117.60 to yield 6.573 percent.
Strong gold shares helped Canadian equities avoid a deeper sell-off in New York. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was earlier down over 200 points before recouping some of its losses.
